name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' is a conditional rule, correctly captured by the hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled), which requires the switch to be toggled after (or on the step) each ring. The siren ringing is a condition trigger, not a commanded goal, so no Existence clause is needed and the rule-only warning is valid.

texts: Whenever the siren is ringing, toggle the switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
